scope: Clarifies the existing U32 diagnostic seal_acquire_count and ownership allocation ordering. No field/type/layout/signature/framecap/sourceclock/oldfile changes.

seal_acquire_count.storage: ContextHeader.seal_acquire_count uint32_t at the previously proposed offset; initially0.
seal_acquire_count.domain: Count successful D4VR_OwnedWriterSealV1 ownership acquisitions only, including later repeated Seal after Drop. It is NOT a count of frames, firstSeal, Retain, Copy, Drop, source events or allleases.
seal_acquire_count.update: On each successful Seal that commits a fresh alias, increment if below UINT32_MAX; otherwise remain UINT32_MAX (saturating diagnostic). A saturated value is only a lower-bound diagnostic, never an allocator, new generation, source fault, payload mutation or implicit control quota.
seal_acquire_count.failed_control: NOT_READY/INVALID/DISABLED/FAULT/QUOTA and structurally invalid calls never increment it; failed validation makes no writes per base contract. Retain can create a distinct alias but does NOT increment this Seal-only diagnostic.

alias_allocation_order: Perform ONLY structural pointer-span/alignment/overlap/arithmetic and local scalar checks before locking; no regular mutable run/owner/phase/READY/alias reads yet. Acquire context metadata trylock or return NOT_READY with specified safe outputs, no mutation. THEN validate run/owner/current phase/READY under that context lock. Only independent sticky atomic fault latch may be accessed concurrently outside the lock.

Check that fewer than8 external ownership slots are live BEFORE requesting or incrementing the CoreIssuer owner counter. A ninth simultaneous owner returns QUOTA, no ownerID consumed, no frame change or SOURCE mark/fault. Both Seal and Retain use this rule.

Then use the single loaded-core CoreIssuer checked monotone owner counter under its bounded trylock. Contention returns NOT_READY without allocation; exhausted U64 counter returns QUOTA without wrap/reuse/faulting the source or old immutable payload.

Commit one distinct issuer ID into one free alias slot and update external_owners together. Update Header.next_owner_id cache to the observed issuer high-water value; PublicStatus.next_alias_id is that diagnostic cache only, never an allocator or promised next alias.

For successful Seal, apply the saturating U32 diagnostic rule. Retain shares the same payload but leaves the Seal-only diagnostic unchanged. Safe output commit follows structural validation; Copy never creates a lease.
preservation: Last Drop does not reopen capture, free the context-owned payload, reset counters or replace frame_generation. Existing valid owners and exact raw bytes remain usable under the base contract after expected control errors or late SOURCE operational faults. No guarantee of infinitely many new IDs; exhaustion is explicit QUOTA.
CPU_and_runtime_scope: Documentation only. No C ABI/header/implementation/probe/compile/test/model/vendor/PE/Wine/GPU executed or admitted.

revision.scope: Only clarify context state is validated UNDER metadata lock, after structural pointer/scalar validation; no ABI/semanticquota/counterdomain change.

lock_order: The sole nested lock order is context metadata trylock THEN CoreIssuer trylock. No control reads regular context state before acquiring context lock; all alias/READY/run/counter/cache state checked and committed under it. Neither lock spans an original delegate; controls never wait. Issuer contention releases context and returns NOT_READY without allocation/output payload copy.
